The main '''factory''' of the [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturer [[ChandrilTech]] was located on the eastern edge of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Emita/Legends|Emita]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The factory was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
